subject: Update on filter request
text: Hi Sam, after your earlier reply, I checked the order portal again and saw that the replacement filter is now listed as ready for pickup. Since I am still the customer on this account and you are handling the warehouse side, do you want me to collect it tomorrow morning or authorize a courier to deliver it to the north gate? The maintenance window shifts to Monday, so timing matters. Please confirm which warehouse desk to ask for, and whether a colleague can sign for the item if I am pulled into another meeting. I also noticed that the first ticket described a scheduled delivery, while the later message says the item was marked out for delivery without a tracking number. If that discrepancy affects the delivery fee, include the correct amount in your reply, and I will correct the case notes before the next shift. Please also let me know if the serial number on the original invoice is sufficient for the warranty claim, because the unit label is difficult to read. If you need anything else from me, send it today, since I plan to leave the support queue early and finish the weekend handover report. I can wait by the desk if needed. Finally, if the earlier estimate was wrong, do we need to log a service failure code, or can this remain an ordinary scheduling note? Avoid attaching the entire maintenance contract; a line confirming coverage will be enough for my update. This should be concise.
